# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

The corpus contains several hundred short call snippets, but only a modest subset are genuine sales/enquiry calls — the majority are internal logistics chatter (loading status, vehicle/trailer coordination, driver follow-up, bill/e-invoice corrections, godown staff talk, personal calls). The real sales material that is usable for training comes mainly from: **Vijayalakshmi/Varsha, Dhanush, Padmanabhan VK, Satya anna, Nataraj S, Indian Steels, Nitheen Enterprises, Srivari Engineering, RAGAVENDRA M, L Devadass, S Famina Parveen, and P Vinayagamoorthy** threads — these show stock checks, rate quoting, negotiation, PO/payment terms, and TC/quality-certificate disputes. Given the fragmentary, code-switched (Tamil-English) nature of the calls and heavy duplication of trivial "check பண்ணிட்டு சொல்றேன்" exchanges, this KB is built conservatively, grounded only in what is explicitly said. No roofing, no retail counter-sale script, no credit-scheme product is invented — only what appears.

## Products & brand ladder

BSC is a **structural/flat steel stockist-distributor** (not a manufacturer), dealing in:

- **MS Plates** — wide thickness range actually mentioned: 4mm, 4.8mm, 5mm, 5.8mm, 6mm, 6.3mm, 8mm, 10mm, 12mm, 16mm, 20mm, 25mm, 30mm, 32mm. Standard sheet sizes repeatedly quoted: **1250×2500mm** and **1500×6300mm / 2500×6300mm**, full 12-meter coil-derived sheets.
- **Checkered (Checked) plates** — e.g. "சக்கரை plate 6 mm 8x4" — used by fabricators; JSW brand mentioned for checked plate specifically.
- **Structural Channels** — sizes called out: 75×40, 100mm, 125mm, 150mm, 175/75 (confirmed as *not* a standard — only 150 or 250 exist), 250mm.
- **Beams/Joists** — MPB/NPB/WBP series: 250, 300, 450 referenced ("300 MPB 36 kg", "450 MPB 6 meter").
- **Angles** — 50×6, 65×6 car sizes; local vs "main" (mill-rolled) distinction discussed.
- **MS Pipes/Tubes** — 273mm, 406mm diameter mentioned (Suresh thread) — tube/HR items occasionally brought up but noted as "tube items not in our range" in some calls.
- **HR Coils** — 1.6mm–3mm, widths like 1250mm, 1030mm ("103 size"), sourced partly ex-Salem.
- **TMT Rods** — mentioned in a couple of calls (straight/bend rod, Vizag make, Jindal make referenced once) — clearly a secondary line, not core.

**Brand/grade ladder used in calls:**
- Grades: **E250** (base/default), **E350** (higher strength, frequently demanded by structural fabrication customers — "structural-ல எல்லாரும் E350 கேக்குறாங்க"), **E450** (premium, used when 5.8/6mm E250 unavailable, ~₹7,000–8,000/ton costlier).
- Mill brands: **SAIL/Vizag (VSP)**, **NMDC** (explicitly explained as having split off from SAIL ~6 months ago, still seen as a "government brand"), **JSW** (checkered plate), occasional reference to **Jindal (JSPL)**, **Posco** (customer-preferred, BSC doesn't always stock it and will "buy out and quote with margin" only if it secures the order).
- BSC's internal stance: "SAIL and Vizag deal பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்" is the standard answer when asked what's available — these are the default go-to brands quoted first.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- Checkered/MS plate 6mm 8×4: **₹62,500** (Vinayagamoorthy thread), later same item still **₹62,500** ("அதேதான் இருக்கு, rate குறையலையான்னு கேட்டேன்").
- Angle 40 car (local/rolling): **₹50**; Angle 50 car Vizag "main": **₹62**.
- Channel 65 car angle VSP sale: **₹62**.
- 32mm plate cut sizes: **₹64,300** initially quoted; after push-back from customer and internal approval, settled at **₹66** (₹66,000-equivalent) including cutting; customer wanted ₹63–64.
- HR coil 3mm, 1250 width: discussed ex-Salem/Chennai; a separate coil deal with L Devadass: quoted **₹58,500**, negotiated down with customer pushing for **₹57,500**, final compromise around **₹58,000** for a 20-ton coil-to-coil order.
- 1.8/25mm plate (Famina Parveen thread): **₹62,500 + loading charge added separately**; earlier related items at ₹58–60.
- TMT 10mm/12mm (Mohd Tanveer/SFE Chennai): **₹55,510–55,500** range, **+₹10,000 transport** for Varagalam delivery.
